title: Days of an Equipment Rental and Demo Extension Given Free to Passholding Riders
content:
A rider whose season pass is scanned at the collective's lifts through the winter keeps kit longer on easier terms, and days of the extension are given free.

## The rule

Where the rider holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season, and the pass account carries at least 6 lift scans in the three months before the extension is priced, the regular skier free days are given free. The regular skier free days are 2.

Where the rider holds a Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season and the pass account carries fewer than 6 lift scans in those three months, the passholder free days are given free instead. The passholder free days are 1.

In any other case no day of the extension is given free under this heading.

## The conditions in combination

| Season Pass Programme pass standing active for the season | Lift scans on the pass account in the three months before the extension is priced | Days given free |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 6 or more | 2 |
| yes | 5 or fewer | 1 |
| no pass, or a pass not standing active | not counted | none under this heading |

The scan count of 6 is met by 6 scans and not by 5, and the window is the three months running back from the day the extension is priced.

## Worked counts on a hypothetical extension

Take an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement on which 4 extra days have been asked for.

- The rider's pass stands active for the season and the pass account shows 9 lift scans inside the three months: 2 days are given free, leaving 2 days to be charged for.
- The rider's pass stands active for the season and the pass account shows 3 lift scans inside the three months: 1 day is given free, leaving 3 days to be charged for.
- The rider holds no pass standing active for the season: no day is given free under this heading, and 4 days stand to be charged for.

## Point of judgement

**Whose pass is read.** The pass read is one held by the rider on the agreement, standing active for the season the agreement belongs to; a pass standing in any other state opens neither row.
